title: ProtAgents: Protein discovery by combining physics and machine learning

defines.name: ProtAgents
defines.definition: A dynamic multi-agent LLM framework for automated protein design and analysis that combines specialized agents and external tools to solve complex protein-related tasks.

problem: Existing protein design methods are often too specialized and cannot flexibly combine out-of-domain knowledge, physics-based simulation, retrieval, and analysis in one automated workflow.
